name: build_designer_disconnected_connectors
why: Live (main lab box): from an empty playbook open in the designer the
analyst asked for a manual-input IP prompt, a ServiceNow ticket and a
FortiGate block. Both connectors were configured but Disconnected; the
model called that a blocker, built a placeholder alert record (then
VirusTotal) instead, dropped the prompt, and triggered on `workflows`
(the designer's own record). Configured is the bar for authoring.
The ask is the analyst's own words from that session, typo included.

steps.user: Create a new playbook triggered from an alert: enrihc and human approval and contain on a fortigate, then lets open a ticket on servicenow

assertions.note: enrichment + containment + ticket are all connector steps
trigger is not the designer's own record
